experience.description: Designed a multi-service FastAPI backend, splitting authentication and data validation into two independently deployable microservices communicating over REST. Implemented JWT-based authentication and authorization with bcrypt password hashing; integrated SQLAlchemy ORM with PostgreSQL for secure, efficient data management. Built a dynamic CSV validation engine using Pandera with configurable, database-stored validation rules, processing large files in chunks via Pandas to avoid memory overload. Configured Nginx as a reverse proxy across services and containerized the full stack using Docker and docker-compose for consistent deployment across environments. Set up a Jenkins CI/CD pipeline running in Docker to automate build and deployment workflows, reducing manual release effort.

projects.name: AI-Powered Portfolio & JD Matching Assistant
projects.description: Built and deployed a fully production-ready LLM-powered portfolio assistant that enables recruiters to interact with a candidate through a conversational chatbot and ask contextual questions about skills, experience, projects, and professional background. Developed an AI resume parsing pipeline that extracts information from PDF/DOCX resumes and converts unstructured resume content into structured candidate profiles using Groq LLMs, Pydantic models, JSON Schema, and structured JSON outputs. Designed prompt-engineering workflows with role definition, task constraints, source-of-truth rules, fallback handling, and hallucination prevention to keep responses grounded in verified candidate information. Implemented conversation history and streaming LLM responses using FastAPI and JavaScript to provide a ChatGPT-like conversational experience with incremental response rendering. Built an AI-powered JD matching feature that analyzes uploaded job descriptions against the candidate profile and generates match percentage, matched skills, missing skills, relevant experience/projects, and an explanation. Implemented PDF/DOCX document processing, temporary file cleanup, input validation, CORS configuration, environment-based API key management, and deployment cleanup for reliable production operation. Deployed the FastAPI backend on Render and frontend on Vercel, integrating both through REST APIs and validating the complete application flow in the deployed environment.
responsibilities: Set up CI/CD and cloud deployment

projects.name: Customer Segmentation And Purchase Prediction System
projects.description: Developed an AI-powered analytics system to process CSV data for RFM analysis, churn prediction, customer segmentation, and market basket analysis to support targeted marketing strategies. Built and trained deep learning models using TensorFlow/Keras to identify churn-prone customers and segment users based on behavioral patterns. Performed data preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis using Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn to improve data quality and model performance. Created an interactive web application using Flask and Streamlit to enable data upload, visualization of insights, and access to predictive outputs.
responsibilities: Developed data pipelines and preprocessing scripts
Trained and evaluated deep learning models
